subject.title: [Feature]: Intelligent Model Fallback with Wildcard/Auto Selection

question: Which provider-family fallback contract should OpenClaw support for text agent failover: wildcard/auto refs, grouped fallbackFamilies, catalog-derived fallbacks, or explicit flat fallbacks only?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but each alternative creates different public config and provider-routing semantics that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Choose one canonical fallback contract
options.body: Adopt one design and land it across schema, normalization, candidate construction, availability gates, docs, and tests.

options.title: Narrow to catalog-derived fallbacks
options.body: Use the narrower direction from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/60922 and leave wildcard/auto and fallbackFamilies out of scope for now.

options.title: Keep explicit fallbacks only
options.body: Document explicit fallbacks and auth order as the supported operator path, then close this feature direction as not planned.

recommendation.title: Choose one canonical fallback contract
recommendation.body: Adopt one design and land it across schema, normalization, candidate construction, availability gates, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest local history signal is repeated work on the central model fallback resolver, config helper, and fallback availability gate.
